resources.string: Choose a password for your PDFs. To use protection in the app, confirm your identity with your fingerprint or screen lock.
Set up your PDF password below.
Changing the password applies to future protection. Documents already protected keep their previous passwords, stored securely on this device. Exported PDFs also keep the password used when exported.
Use at least 8 characters and a password you can remember.
Use at least 8 characters. If the password is too long, shorten it.
You will no longer have a default password for new protection. Existing documents and exported PDFs will remain protected with their current passwords.
Default password deactivated. Previous versions have been kept.
On this Android version, biometrics require additional authorization. Screen lock is still available as an alternative.
Authentication was not completed. Try again.
Could not update settings. Your documents have been kept.
Set up a screen lock PIN, pattern, or password in Android settings to continue.
Secure access on this device is unavailable. You can set a new default password. Existing PDFs will be kept, but you may need to enter their original passwords to open them.
Documents will not be deleted. To recover previously protected PDFs, you need to know their original passwords. The new password will apply to future protection.
The password for this document is unavailable. Use the original PDF password to recover it.
